intro: Kor'ghan is a Darkspear jungle troll who can be found lingering in the murky caverns of the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. Positioned right outside Rekkul's Poisons, he seeks assistance in concocting remedies against venomous wilderness predators.

p: Standing before Rekkul's Poisons in the cavernous depths of the Cleft of Shadow, Kor'ghan keeps close watch over remedies and toxins alike. From the capital he dispatches adventurers across the red canyons to gather venomous components from Durotar's scorpids in order to prepare vital antidotes.
